title: I created a bot, I would like to get your feedback on it, pls🙏
author: Ok_Zucchini4971
selftext:
Hello everyone! I've been working on a trading bot for several months. Initially, it was just an indicator, but now it's a standalone bot. I think it's quite interesting and, most importantly, it works. This is the first bot I've created that's actually generating some profit. I'd be interested in testing it and getting your feedback. Maybe you'll have any ideas or comments; I'd be truly grateful for any honest feedback!
